title: Paul Appeals for Onesimus as a Brother
summary_text: Paul thanks God for Philemon's faith in Christ and his love for the saints, the people who belong to God. Writing as a prisoner, he appeals out of love for Onesimus, whom he calls his child. Paul sends him back and asks Philemon to welcome him as a beloved brother, beyond his standing as a slave. He offers to repay anything Onesimus owes and trusts Philemon to do even more than he asks. Paul also requests a guest room, hoping that their prayers will lead to his return.
key_points: Philemon's love has encouraged the saints, and Paul prays for his partnership in the faith.
Paul appeals for Onesimus out of love and leaves Philemon free to choose his response.
Paul asks Philemon to receive Onesimus as a beloved brother and as he would receive Paul.
Paul offers to repay Onesimus's debts and asks for a room in hope of returning.
